text:
Asha: Quick sync — Thunderclap kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. They need streaming + function/tool calling + strict structured JSON output. Also security questionnaire inbound. Can we confirm what to show in the POC and any enterprise blockers?

Sam: I can ship JS + Rust sample apps for streaming. Do they want SSE or WebSocket?

Asha: SSE + resume support requested. Also they asked about ephemeral creds and token rotation.

Jia: For SSE resume we recommend ephemeral creds + short TTL and the session resume token pattern. Note: streaming + function calls -> make sure to demo both streaming deltas and final structured JSON payload. We should show schema enforcement and graceful degradation when schema validation fails.

Evan (presales): I'll draft a pricing ballpark for 1M tokens/mo streaming + a reserved capacity option. Also heads-up: their infosec insists on KMS with HSM and EU data residency for logs. That pushes them to Dedicated or Private.

Sam: I'll prepare a short runbook and sample code. Example JS stream snippet I'll include in the repo: 
```js
const stream = await Redwood.stream({ model: 'open-variant', stream: true });
stream.on('delta', d => handleDelta(d));
stream.on('end', full => validateSchema(full, schema));
```

Jia: For function/tool calling sample we should show the tool schema and a streaming tool response. Example schema: name + params JSON schema. Emphasize how to flush partial tool outputs and rehydrate into KV cache.

Asha: Blocker: their legal team will ask for an addendum for key management and audit logs. We support exported audit logs for Dedicated/Private but hosted needs a retention add-on. Evan - can you loop in AM + Legal?

Evan (presales): Yep, looping AM + legal. I'll request a template addendum and confirm SLA uplift options. For the pricing note: baseline reserved GPU + per-token streaming delta fees. I'll post concrete #'s after AM confirms commit size.

Sam: Uploaded initial samples to repo (private link): https://github.com/redwood/sales-thunderclap-poc (commit abc123). Includes: js-sse, rust-ws, structured-output examples, runbook.md.

deploy-bot: Deployed demo env to staging -> https://staging.redwood-demo/thunderclap (branch: sales/thunderclap, commit abc123).

Jia: Quick tech note: structured output validation supports both strict and non-strict modes. For demo, show strict=true to prove enforcement, then strict=false fallback to show graceful fallback + schema errors in telemetry. Also mention KV cache warmup latency on first few requests; recommend prewarm script in runbook.

Asha: Action items: Sam -> finalize and push language samples + demo app; Jia -> write streaming runbook + structured-output playbook; Evan -> pricing, AM/legal intro, and security addendum ask. I'll update the calendar invite with a 20min tech demo window.

Sam: On it. Will also include a minimal test harness that simulates reconnects and resume tokens.

Evan (presales): FYI I added security Q highlights in the thread: SOC2, EU region hosting, HSM KMS, audit log retention. If they require on-prem, we should flag infra lead.

Asha: Thanks. If anyone hits a blocker today ping me @asha directly.

Jia: One more: confirm whether their schema includes binary blobs or attachments. If yes, show multipart upload pattern and explain cost for embedding vs direct storage.

Sam: Noted. I'll add a sample multipart demo and a cost estimate note in runbook.

Evan (presales): I'll follow up with a short email summarizing the POC scope and pricing options after I talk to AM/legal.

Asha: Great — closing this thread for now, will reopen after Evan posts numbers. :thumbsup:
